responsibility: Instruction handler for BRIG atomic operations that lowers BRIG atomic and wait-style memory instructions to GCC GENERIC expressions and builtin calls. It builds typed atomic memory references, selects appropriate GCC sync builtins or BRIG-specific HSAIL builtins based on opcode and data width, handles special cases such as load/store and compare-and-swap, and emits either result assignments or side-effect statements into the current BRIG function.
